lines.text: I sent eight soldiers at my flying mothership.
Not one of them could touch it. It just floats over their heads.
That's a rule in my game. Every attack says if it hits the ground, the air, or both. Swords only hit the ground.
So the answer isn't more swords. It's Ion Rangers. They shoot up.
Five of them bring it down.
Fair? Or should swords hit flying units too?
